page_title: ATA 2-0 UDI | Atalanta v Udinese 27/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+2' Luis Muriel (Atalanta) blasts the ball high over the crossbar.
90+1' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
88' The referee signals a substitution. Luis Muriel (Atalanta) is brought on as a substitute for Aleksey Miranchuk.
85' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) is flagged for offside.
80' Substitution. Jose Luis Palomino (Atalanta) in, Giorgio Scalvini out.
80' Gabriele Cioffi has decided to make a change. Brenner (Udinese) replaces Sandi Lovric.
79' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) sends a direct shot in from the free kick that's in a promising position. The ball sails towards the right post, but the goalkeeper prevents a goal with a quick save.
77' Marco Piccinini shows a yellow card to Ederson (Atalanta), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
76' Today's match ends for Hassane Kamara who will be replaced by Jordan Zemura (Udinese).
75' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) has tested the patience of referee Marco Piccinini and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
74' Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
69' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to substitute Gianluca Scamacca and he is replaced by Mario Pasalic (Atalanta).
69' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Emil Holm as he is replaced by Hans Hateboer (Atalanta).
69' Substitution. Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) replaces Matteo Ruggeri.
64' Marco Piccinini blows for a foul after Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
61' Gabriele Cioffi decides to make a substitution. Florian Thauvin will be replaced by Roberto Pereyra (Udinese).
61' We are about to witness a subsitution. Martin Payero (Udinese) for Lazar Samardzic.
58' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
57' The game is interrupted as Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) is flagged offside.
56' Emil Holm (Atalanta) makes a good run inside the box to meet a precise cross. He latches on to it and shoots, but the goalkeeper pulls off an excellent save.
56' Atalanta take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
55' Emil Holm (Atalanta) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball goes out for a corner. Atalanta can continue in their attacking effort.
55' The number of shots on goal at present is 8:3.
50' Udinese have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
48' The corner evades everyone in the centre and ends up at the back post where Nehuen Perez (Udinese) sends a wild header high over the bar.
47' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.

47' Thomas Kristensen (Udinese) picks up a pass and hits the ball towards the top of the net, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Marco Carnesecchi. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Udinese.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Gabriele Cioffi probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Festy Ebosele (Udinese). He is replaced by Kingsley Ehizibue.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.

45+2' Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the right side of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
45+2' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Atalanta will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

45+1' 2 - 0 GOAL! Superb work from Charles De Ketelaere, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta), who beats Maduka Okoye with a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. 2:0.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
44' A player from Udinese commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
44' The ball goes out of play. Udinese are awarded a corner kick.

44' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Marco Carnesecchi makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the top left corner. The referee signals a corner kick to Udinese.
43' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.
42' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) picks up a pass and hits the ball towards the bottom right corner, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Maduka Okoye.
41' A neat pass is well received by Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball on goal. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
38' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Atalanta.
37' A pass into the box finds Festy Ebosele (Udinese) unmarked. He carefully places a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Marco Carnesecchi denies him.
33' 1 - 0 Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) scores as he latches on to a pass inside the penalty box and fires a perfect low strike that goes inside the right post. What a clinical goal!
28' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Thomas Kristensen (Udinese) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
25' Atalanta couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Maduka Okoye (Udinese) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
23' Joao Ferreira (Udinese) commits a rough challenge and Marco Piccinini blows his whistle for a foul.
21' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots towards the middle of the goal. Maduka Okoye is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save.

19' Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) receives a short pass inside a congested penalty area and takes a first-time shot. The effort heads towards the middle of the goal but Maduka Okoye blocks the shot with his legs.
17' What a miskick by Festy Ebosele (Udinese). He smashes a volley from long distance that goes into the stands.
16' Udinese work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
16' Nehuen Perez (Udinese) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. Udinese will take a corner kick.
14' Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
12' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) volleys the ball on the edge of the box after a rebound. It's a great effort and has Maduka Okoye scrambling, but it flies just wide of the right post.
11' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header directed into the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop his effort.
10' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Atalanta, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
9' A cross from Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
8' Half-chance! Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) plays a pass into the box, but Marco Carnesecchi reacts well to snuff out the attack.
5' Emil Holm (Atalanta) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
4' Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
2' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) jumps for a cross in the goal area and produces a fine header which goes narrowly wide of the left post! What a huge opportunity!
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Udinese will have the kick-off.
Marco Piccinini got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
